glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形): a snake. This is now written as the derivative 蛇. Jiajie (假借 phonetic loan): the character was later borrowed for the then-homophonous third-person pronoun (“he/she/it”). Today 他 is used for male or gender-unspecified “he” and 她 for “she”.
senses: [tā] third-person singular pronoun for inanimate objects; it
[tā] (chiefly, simplified Chinese) third-person singular pronoun for animals; it
